name: Shopify
summary: Custom distribution (one store, or stores in one Plus org) needs no review. Public distribution means App Store review, a one-time registration fee, and a separate review to access protected customer data such as names and emails. Your distribution choice is permanent.

composio.note: Composio lists this toolkit but you must bring your own OAuth app (client ID + secret) in a custom auth config.

steps.title: Create a Partner organization and the app
steps.detail: Create it in the Dev Dashboard with the Shopify CLI. Add redirect URLs (Composio BYO: https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback).
steps.agent: Scaffold with the Shopify CLI and set scopes and redirects
steps.human: Sign up for the Partner org

steps.title: Choose the distribution method (permanent)
steps.detail: Custom (one store or one Plus org) or Public (App Store). **You can't change it later.** If you have separate dev and prod apps, choose on the prod app.

steps.title: Request protected customer data access
steps.detail: Declare which fields you need and why, and meet the level 1 (or level 2) requirements. Until it's approved, the API won't return that data from non-dev stores.
steps.agent: Draft the data-use justification and implement the requirements (encryption, retention)

steps.title: Register for the App Store and build the listing
steps.detail: One-time registration fee. You need the listing, an app icon, compliance webhooks, and billing via Shopify App Pricing if you charge.
steps.agent: Subscribe the compliance webhooks; draft the listing; run Shopify's AI self-review

steps.title: Submit for App Store review
steps.detail: Status moves Draft → Submitted → Reviewed → Published. If core requirements fail, the app goes to Paused.

launchToday: Use custom distribution for your first merchant today: install link, no review.
Composio has no managed Shopify app (bring your own).
File the protected customer data request early if you need customer PII.
rejections: Requesting access scopes you can't justify
Submitting a beta or incomplete app
Billing outside Shopify App Pricing for public apps

blockers.problem: API returns null for customer fields
blockers.fix: You don't have protected customer data access yet. Request it in the dashboard. Development stores work without it.

blockers.problem: “App not found” when connecting via Composio
blockers.fix: Check the store's myshopify domain and that your app's distribution allows that store.

uncertain: The discovery probe found accounts.shopify.com, which is Shopify's own identity service. App OAuth runs per store at https://{shop}.myshopify.com/admin/oauth/authorize, which has no discovery document.
Shopify doesn't state the review turnaround on the cited pages. The ranges are estimates.
The exact registration fee isn't on the cited pages.
